- Push a small box onto a pressure pad next to the left display to release a [Rope]
- Climb it, jump through a hole, and pull the [Lever]
- Push all three small boxes onto the large pressure pad on the left so the displays read '23 03'
- Open the crate and take the can!

markers.title: Button
markers.desc: Pressed to access a bunker that's part of the [Looking for my Brother] request from a bulletin board.

markers.title: Password-Protected Keypad
markers.desc:
In front of a shipping container in the upper half of the ship.

Its password (**βθαλδζ**) is pieced together by finding all six Chapter of Trial documents, listed below.

- [Chapter of Trial 1-β] (Matrix 11)
- [Chapter of Trial 2-θ] (Great Desert)
- [Chapter of Trial 3-α] (Great Desert)
- [Chapter of Trial 4-λ] (Great Desert)
- [Chapter of Trial 5-δ] (Wasteland)
- [Chapter of Trial 6-ζ] (Wasteland)

markers.title: Cryo Zero Robot Spot #1
markers.desc:
Open the box here to find a flying robot carrying a can.

Shoot it, then follow it to its [next spot.]

markers.title: Cryo Zero Robot Spot #2
markers.desc:
After opening [the box] and shooting the robot, it will relocate here.

Shoot it again to send it towards its [final spot.]

markers.title: Ball
markers.desc: Push it over to the pressure pads [here] to unlock a can.

markers.title: Locked Gate
markers.desc: Approach from the northern side to unlock it.

markers.title: Gate Box #2
markers.desc: Push [Gate Box #1] over to the nearby pressure pad to gain access to it.

markers.title: Gate Box #1
markers.desc: In front of the half-open gate. Push it over to the pressure pad in the south-eastern corner of the area to gain access to [Gate Box #2]

markers.title: Pressure Pad Gate
markers.desc: A gate that will only open once [Gate Box #1] and [Gate Box #2] are placed on the nearby pressure pads.

markers.title: Gate Box #3
markers.desc:
Behind a shutter that remains closed until you push [Gate Box #1] or [Gate Box #2] onto the pressure pad next to it.

Once the [Pressure Pad Gate] is opened, you need to push this box onto the large pressure pad to spawn a [Rope].

markers.title: Ticker
markers.desc:
On a platform reached by using the [Ledges & Swinging Bars].

The first machine you'll activate as part of [Plan to Clean the Earth].

markers.title: Pressure Pad Gate
markers.desc:
In the scrap yard. 

To open it, approach from the west and push the two small boxes onto the nearby pressure pads on either side of the gate.

markers.title: Clunker
markers.desc:
At the top of a tower, scaled via ladder. Open the [Pressure Pad Gate] and push a large box beneath the ladder to reach it.

The third and final machine you'll activate as part of [Plan to Clean the Earth].

markers.title: Buzzer
markers.desc:
On top of a ledge. To reach it, you'll need to climb on a large crate to reach the platform below and push a small crate onto a nearby pressure pad.

This lowers a shutter, letting you push another large crate into the newly-opened area and climb on top of it to reach the Buzzer.

The second machine you'll activate as part of [Plan to Clean the Earth].

markers.title: Locked Gate
markers.desc: Approach from the northern side (by using the [Narrow Beams] on the road above) to unlock it.

markers.title: Cargo
markers.desc:
At the edge of the clearing.

Target of the [Valuable Cargo] quest from the [Bulletin Board].

markers.title: Lever
markers.desc:
At the top of some stairs at the end of the valley.

Temporarily lowers a platform used to reach the [Corsair Lager].

markers.title: Generator
markers.desc:
Restores power to the [Powerless Panel] - but only after all five of the targets below have been killed.

- [Repair Droid #1]
- [Repair Droid #2]
- [Repair Droid #3]
- [Repair Droid #4]
- [Repair Droid #5]

markers.title: Powerless Panel
markers.desc:
Use the [Generator] to restore power after all five of the targets below are dead.



- [Repair Droid #1]
- [Repair Droid #2]
- [Repair Droid #3]
- [Repair Droid #4]
- [Repair Droid #5]

markers.title: Repair Droid #2
markers.desc:
At the bottom of a pole on the hill.

One of five droids that must be destroyed to restore power to the [Powerless Panel].

_Tip: If the droids aren't taking any damage, leave and re-enter the Wasteland and fast travel over here._

markers.title: Crane Box #3
markers.desc:
At the top of some stairs on a platform above the water.

Push it onto the nearby pressure pad to get one step closer to finding [The Machinetta Cafe Latte].

markers.title: Crane Box #1
markers.desc:
On a low-down platform above the water.

Push it onto the nearby pressure pad to get one step closer to [The Machinetta Cafe Latte].

markers.title: Crane Box #2
markers.desc:
Next to some stairs on a low-down platform near the water.

Push it onto the nearby pressure pad to get one step closer to finding [The Machinetta Cafe Latte].

markers.title: Locked Gate
markers.desc: Approach from the western side to unlock it.

markers.title: Locked Gate
markers.desc:
In the narrow valley. 

Use the [Ledges & Swinging Bars] at the top of the nearby cliffs to reach the area behind the gate and unlock it from the western side.

markers.title: Locked Gate
markers.desc: Approach from the western side to unlock it.

markers.title: Lever
markers.desc:
In an enclosed room holding a box.

To reach it, use the [Rope] and jump through a hole in the roof.

markers.title: Repair Droid #5
markers.desc:
Next to the [Generator].

One of five droids that must be destroyed to restore power to the [Powerless Panel].

_Tip: If the droids aren't taking any damage, leave and re-enter the Wasteland and fast travel over here._

markers.title: Repair Droid #1
markers.desc:
Near the top of a pole.

One of five droids that must be destroyed to restore power to the [Powerless Panel].

_Tip: If the droids aren't taking any damage, leave and re-enter the Wasteland and fast travel over here._

markers.title: Repair Droid #3
markers.desc:
Near the top of a pole (and easier to shoot from the top of the nearby hill path).

One of five droids that must be destroyed to restore power to the [Powerless Panel].

_Tip: If the droids aren't taking any damage, leave and re-enter the Wasteland and fast travel over here._

markers.title: Repair Droid #4
markers.desc:
At the top of a large pole.

One of five droids that must be destroyed to restore power to the [Powerless Panel].

_Tip: If the droids aren't taking any damage, leave and re-enter the Wasteland and fast travel over here._

markers.title: Arin
markers.desc: Appears on top of the hill here during the [Stolen Treasure] side quest.

markers.title: Su's Weapon
markers.desc:
Leaning against some boxes next to a flag.

Only appears here during the [Keeping Secrets] side quest.

markers.title: Dead Naytiba
markers.desc:
A few corpses leaning against the wrecked bus.

Only appears here during the [Keeping Secrets] side quest.

markers.title: Su
markers.desc:
Inside the wrecked ship. Head through a shipping container to find him sitting against a wall in a hidden room.

Only appears here during the [Keeping Secrets] side quest.

markers.title: Can Terminal #2
markers.desc:
Next to a box on top of the shipping containers. Use the [Large Box] to reach it.

One of four terminals that must be activated to obtain the [Potential Tempest] can.

markers.title: Can Terminal #3
markers.desc:
Next to a pole and pile of scrap metal at the edge of the area.

One of four terminals that must be activated to obtain the [Potential Tempest] can.

markers.title: Can Terminal #4
markers.desc:
By the edge of the cliff.

One of four terminals that must be activated to obtain the [Potential Tempest] can.

markers.title: Can Terminal #1
markers.desc:
Next to a pole and large box at the edge of the area.

One of four terminals that must be activated to obtain the [Potential Tempest] can.

markers.title: Militaria
markers.desc:
**Prerequisite:** Own and install the Stellar Blade x GODDESS OF VICTORY: NIKKE DLC.

Special weapon. Unlocked after a cutscene that begins when you interact with the dog sitting here.
